jobs.title: Vice President, Global Consumer Data & Insights
jobs.description:
Your Opportunity at ARC’TERYX:

As the Vice President, Global Consumer Data & Insights, you are a trusted advisor and strategic partner to the Brand Leadership team and to the Enterprise organization, shaping the future of the Arc’teryx brand through deep consumer understanding and insight-led strategy. You will define and lead the company’s Consumer Insights vision, ensuring the voice of the consumer is embedded at the core of brand and business strategy, decision making and long-term growth.  In this role you influence critical business and brand decisions through compelling storytelling and foresight, translating complex data into clear direction for senior leaders.

Acting as a catalyst for a consumer-first culture, you lead the growth of the company’s insights capabilities, operating models, and tools while building a high-performing global team. You also champion innovation in how the organization anticipates and responds to shifting consumer behaviors, ensuring the brand remains culturally relevant and positioned for sustained growth.

Ideally this role is based out of our North Vancouver office.

Meet Your Future Team:

The Brand team is the direct connection between the guest and the core intention of the Arc’teryx brand. Leveraging an increasingly robust set of consumer insights, we specialize in storytelling and creating incredible experiences that connect people to the transformative power of the mountains. Our functions include enterprise strategy, brand marketing and creative, athletes/ambassador's programs, community, experiences, operations, communications, regional teams, and agency partners. This team is comprised of global HQ and regional offices who aim to become the voice of the consumer within the organization.  You will work in close partnership with functional leaders across channels and regions to bring added value to the business during this high growth era.

You and your team will also support wider executive leadership, aggregating data from commercial, product and business partners to derive insights that inform the enterprise growth strategy.

If you were in the VP, Global Consumer Data & Insights role now, here are some of the core activities you would be doing:

Setting the strategic vision and multi-year roadmap for the global Consumer Insights function, strengthening brand equity, distinctiveness, and consumer connection while ensuring alignment to brand positioning, growth priorities, and long-term strategy

Serving as the enterprise leader and trusted advisor for consumer insights, embedding a consumer-first operating model and insight-led perspectives that shape executive decisions, strategic planning, and innovation across all functions, regions, and business units.

Building, leading, and developing a high-performing global Consumer Insights team, including organizational design, capability building, and succession planning

Translating complex, multi-source data into clear narratives and lead the evolution of advanced analytics, including predictive, prescriptive, and AI-driven approaches, next-gen measurement, and marketing effectiveness/ROI tools, to drive measurable business outcomes

Designing and scaling a global insights operating model and enterprise frameworks — tools, platforms, KPIs, and standardized methodologies — and build strategic external partnerships (agencies, data providers, industry experts) to democratize access and ensure best-in-class capability

Leading consumer segmentation and consolidate data and insights systems across the enterprise (with focus on product, channel, and regional data), anticipating emerging consumer behaviors and market dynamics to unlock acquisition, retention, and growth opportunities

Here are some of the things you could be working on in the future:

Shaping the future of brand-building through next-generation insights, leveraging AI, real-time consumer signals, and emerging technologies to create more adaptive, responsive, and culturally relevant brand strategies

Pioneering new approaches to understanding consumer connection and brand experience, evolving beyond traditional research to integrate behavioral, emotional, and cultural intelligence at scale

Future-proofing the Brand by embedding predictive foresight and scenario planning, enabling the organization to anticipate disruption, stay ahead of shifting consumer expectations, and unlock long-term brand growth opportunities

Are you our next VP, Global Consumer Data & Insights?

You have 15+ years of progressive experience across brand, consumer insights, and strategy functions, with a bachelor's degree in a relevant field, and proven capability building consumer insights strategies and frameworks

You have demonstrated success influencing executive leadership, translating insights into brand strategy, positioning, and global brand-building initiatives that drive equity and long-term growth

You have strong analytical and technical fluency, including advanced analytics, predictive modeling, AI-driven insights, and consumer data ingestion, integration, and governance across a multi-market environment

You have an exceptional ability to synthesize complex data into compelling narratives that influence senior stakeholders and drive action

You are a proven people leader who sets clear vision, aligns global teams and cross-functional partners, and builds high-performing, diverse organizations within a complex matrix environment.

Your knowledge of technical apparel, outdoor, performance, or premium lifestyle categories, with in-depth understanding of the outdoor industry and the consumer culture Arc'teryx targets

You have a genuine passion for getting outside that matches your passion for the work

Compensation:
The salary range for this role is USD$224,000 - USD$336,000 

Total Rewards

Most new team members join between the start and midpoint of the range, where you can contribute right away while continuing to grow your craft, your collaborations, and your impact at Arc’teryx. This range reflects market alignment and the scope of the role. Individual pay is determined by your skills, experience, and level of responsibility.

We’re committed to fair, equitable, and competitive pay, reviewed regularly to ensure internal alignment and market relevance. Transparency is part of how we follow through on our commitments and how we honour the value you bring to our team.

In addition to base pay, Arc’teryx supports people through benefits designed to sustain both work and life:

Health & wellbeing
- Extended health, dental, and vision coverage, including mental health support, fertility benefits, gender-affirming care and a 24/7 Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

Financial wellbeing
- RRSP matching and eligibility for Arc'teryx Annual Incentive Plan and access to Employee Stock Purchase program (ESPP) where applicable.

Time & Flexibilit
y - Paid time off, wellness time, and No Wasted Day program (dedicated paid days to get outside & explore).

Family support
- Parental leave top-up and a nesting period for new parents.

Growth, community & gear
- Professional development opportunities, Arc'teryx Academies (outdoor skill-building events) , Employee Belonging Councils, and access to employee discounts and Pro Deals (exclusive discounted pricing on gear).
  *Eligibility for certain programs may vary by role.

Equal Opportunity

Arc’teryx is committed to actively creating and fostering a culture of inclusivity where voices are heard, people are seen, and values are respected. We care about the uniqueness of our applicants, employees, and guests, and we do so in a safe space fueled by curiosity and acceptance. 

Creating an inclusive workplace is connected to our core value Do Right while also having the added benefit of helping make our business better. We believe inclusion helps us to create a healthier, happier workplace, drive creativity and innovation, and reflect the communities where we operate.  

All applicants, employees, and guests can expect equality of opportunity and fair treatment in alignment with our values.

Leave it Better

We believe that the mountains transform us, that how we adventure matters, and that there’s always a better way. 

Join us in creating positive change in ourselves, our communities, and the world. 

Live it. Get out there - the mountains make us better 
Disruptive evolution . In pursuit of better. Always. 
Commit.  We set bold objectives and see them through.

jobs.title: Director, AI & Agentic Engineering
jobs.description:
About The Job

Do you think like a management consultant, thrive in a startup environment, and can’t stop thinking about the intersection of data, technology, and marketing?

With over 2000 employees, offices on five continents, and world-class clients like Samsung, L’Oreal, and Mattel, Artefact
is a consulting firm that transforms data into value and business impact. We’ve recently launched in the US with offices located in NYC and Los Angeles, and we want you to join us as an integral part of our founding team!

Who We Are

Founded and headquartered in Paris, Artefact is a next-generation consulting firm, specializing in data, analytics & AI consulting, dedicated to transforming data into business impact across the entire value chain of organizations. We are proud to say that we help our clients grow their data and digital capabilities, and that we’re also growing in parallel.

We have 2000 employees across 36 offices who are focused on accelerating digital transformation. Our state-of-the-art data technologies, lean AI agile methodologies, and cohesive teams of the finest business consultants, data analysts, data scientists, data engineers, and digital experts are all dedicated to bringing extra value to every client. We design data-based solutions to meet our clients' specific needs, always conceived with a business-centric approach and delivered with tangible results. Our data-driven services are built upon the deep AI expertise we've acquired with our 1000+ client base around the globe.

Find out more at artefact.com.

What You Will Be Doing

You will lead a team of AI & machine learning engineers and managers, driving the design and delivery of production-grade AI solutions — from classical machine learning models to LLM-powered applications — and the pipelines that power them. You’ll bring senior technical judgment to architecture and model decisions, partner closely with clients and business stakeholders — including hands-on pre-sales work shaping proposals and solution designs — and define how context engineering, agent harnesses, and fine-tuning practices get embedded into every solution, while reporting into senior AI/technology leadership on strategy and priorities.

AI & ML Solution Architecture: Leading the design, build, and optimization of production AI systems — classical machine learning models, LLM applications, and agentic systems — ensuring scalability, reliability, and cost-efficient inference.
Context Engineering: Defining and standardizing context engineering practices — prompt and system design, RAG architectures, vector stores, memory management, and tool/function calling — so models receive the right information at the right time.
Harness Engineering: Directing the build of robust agent harnesses — orchestration layers, evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and observability — that make LLM systems reliable, safe, and measurable in production.
Fine-Tuning Pipelines: Leading the design and operation of fine-tuning and model adaptation pipelines — training data curation, supervised fine-tuning, evaluation, and deployment — to specialize models for client use cases.
Platform Stack: Architecting and deploying solutions on Google Gemini Enterprise and Vertex AI as the primary stack, applying working knowledge of Microsoft AI Foundry and AWS Bedrock where client contexts require.
Team Leadership: Managing, mentoring, and developing a team of AI & ML engineers; setting technical standards and fostering best practices and knowledge sharing.
Pre-Sales & Business Development: Supporting pre-sales activities — scoping engagements, building demos and proofs of concept, and presenting solution architectures to prospective clients alongside account teams.
Machine Learning Modeling: Overseeing the development of classical and modern ML models — predictive modeling, forecasting, recommendation, and deep learning — choosing the right technique for each business problem, LLM or not.
Contributing to AI Strategy: Partnering with senior leadership to shape GenAI architecture direction, tooling decisions, and platform roadmap within your area.

What We Are Looking For

The ideal candidate has a substantial software engineering and AI background with 8+ years of experience, including at least 2–3 years working on LLM architecture, agentic design, and harness & context engineering.
Strong expertise in generative AI/LLM engineering — context engineering, agent harnesses, RAG, and agentic coding — and in cloud-native software architecture, with proven production deployments.
Master’s degree (or higher) in computer science, software engineering, or a related field.
Hands-on command of agentic SDKs (LangGraph/LangChain, Google ADK, Claude Agent SDK), agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Cursor), and modern full-stack frameworks (TypeScript/React front ends; Python/Node backends).
Experience designing cloud architectures: microservices, serverless, containers/Kubernetes, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code.
Solid grasp of AI system design: agents, tool use, evaluation harnesses, guardrails, observability, and LLMOps.
Experience with data & context modeling and ingestion/processing pipelines on data lakes and data warehouses, including vector and graph storage strategies (embeddings, knowledge graphs).
Deep experience with Google Gemini Enterprise / Vertex AI; basic working knowledge of Microsoft AI Foundry and AWS Bedrock.
Experience leading and growing engineering teams, and supporting pre-sales: proposals, demos, and solution scoping with clients.
Excellent communication skills and comfort collaborating across teams and with stakeholders.
Strong business acumen with an interest in business-facing work.
Adaptability and a start-up mentality to thrive in a dynamic environment.

Why Join Us

We are united by our values
and strengthened by our hybrid expertise
.

There is always a way: We're from the breed of does, of diggers, of makers. Because ideas are valuable only if executed.
Client trust is won on the field: Addressing client needs flows better hands on at their side.
If not used, it is useless: Our love for technology translates into a steep desire for adoption, true brilliance is about impact.
If not shared, our work is not done: Sharing knowledge is the best way to button up a mission, benefitting clients and colleagues.
We learn everyday: Tech is a land where everything moves at the speed of light, you better be ready to challenge yourself.

The estimated base compensation for this role starts at $200,000 (NYC location). Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, and experience. In addition, this role is eligible for competitive benefits.

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

The Finance Director serves as a strategic business partner to the Leadership Team in support of Husky’s Global Service Business and Customer Success Management strategy. This role provides leadership for financial planning, forecasting, performance analysis, governance, and decision support to drive profitable growth, improve operational performance, and strengthen financial visibility across service revenue streams, including field service, contracts, parts, and other aftermarket offerings. The Finance Director is expected to influence strategic decisions, lead transformation initiatives, and build a high-performing finance capability that enables the business to scale effectively.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Planning & Forecasting

Lead the annual budget, quarterly forecast, and long-range planning processes for the service business.
Develop robust revenue, margin, cost, and headcount forecasts based on operational and commercial drivers.
Translate business strategies into financial plans with clear assumptions, risks, and opportunities.
Support scenario planning and sensitivity analysis for service growth, pricing, labor utilization, and investment decisions.

Performance Management & Analysis

Deliver timely and accurate monthly financial reporting and variance analysis for service revenue, gross margin, SG&A, and operating income.
Analyze business performance by region, product line, customer segment, channel, and service offering.
Monitor and explain key drivers of performance, including labor utilization, absorption, contract profitability, attach rates, response times, and service productivity.
Provide actionable insights and recommendations to improve growth, profitability, and working capital performance.

Business Partnering

Serve as the senior finance partner to service leadership, operations, commercial teams, and Customer Success leaders, providing insight and challenge on strategic priorities, business performance, and investment decisions.
Lead financial evaluation of pricing strategies, contract renewals, service program design, and capital or operating investments to support sustainable growth and margin expansion.
Provide proactive challenge and decision support to business leaders by identifying risks, opportunities, and trade-offs across growth, productivity, service delivery, and resource allocation.
Lead cross-functional evaluation of new service offerings, business models, and transformation initiatives that improve service coverage, utilization, fulfillment, cost efficiency, and customer value.
Sponsor finance and business transformation initiatives across Finance and Customer Success Management, including enhancements to processes, reporting, operating metrics, and decision frameworks that support growth, profitability, and scalability.

Management Reporting & KPI Development

Develop and enhance dashboards, reporting tools, and KPIs that improve transparency and decision-making.
Standardize definitions and reporting for critical service metrics across the organization.
Improve reporting automation and self-service analytics capabilities where possible.
Present clear financial results and business insights to senior leadership

Process Improvement & Governance

Strengthen forecasting accuracy, reporting discipline, and financial controls within the service business.
Drive continuous improvement in FP&A processes, planning models, and reporting frameworks.
Ensure alignment with corporate finance requirements, accounting policies, and internal controls
Support month-end close and planning processes in partnership with accounting and finance teams.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field required.
CPA, CMA, CFA, or MBA preferred.
10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, finance business partnering, commercial finance, or operational finance, including leadership responsibility.
Experience in a service, aftermarket, field service, maintenance, or contract-based business strongly preferred.
Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and business analysis skills.
Advanced proficiency in Excel and experience with ERP and planning/reporting systems.
Executive presence with strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, and the ability to influence senior leaders across functions and regions.
Proven ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment

Preferred Experience In a Service Business

Understanding of service revenue models such as time and materials, service contracts, preventive maintenance, subscriptions, and parts/service bundles.
Experience analyzing operational KPIs such as technician utilization, service efficiency, contract margins, backlog, renewal rates, and service attach rates.
Familiarity with pricing strategy, labor productivity, installed base analytics, and customer lifecycle economics

Core Competencies

Strategic leadership
Financial and commercial acumen
Analytical rigor
Executive business partnership
Influence and executive communication
Problem solving
Process improvement
Results orientation and a bias for action

Team Development

Build and lead a high-performing finance team with strong capability in financial analysis, strategic thinking, business partnership, and change leadership.
Lead, coach, and develop team members, including succession planning, capability building, and development of future finance leaders.

Financial Leadership

Provide consistent, timely, accurate, and decision-oriented financial reporting for the service business, with greater automation and self-service access to insights where possible

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. jobs.description:
You are as unique as your background, experience and point of view. Here, you’ll be encouraged, empowered and challenged to be your best self. You'll work with dynamic colleagues - experts in their fields - who are eager to share their knowledge with you. Your leaders will inspire and help you reach your potential and soar to new heights. Every day, you'll have new and exciting opportunities to make life brighter for our Clients - who are at the heart of everything we do.

At Sun Life, we're driven by our Purpose: helping our Clients achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives. Our values shape how we work: caring, authentic, bold, inspiring, and impactful.

When you join Sun Life, you'll work with passionate colleagues and empowering leaders who support your growth and celebrate your contributions, so you can make a meaningful difference in our Clients' lives.

Discover how you can make a difference in the lives of individuals, families and communities around the world.

Job Description:

About The Role

The Corporate AVP, Underwriting Risk & Governance is accountable for maintaining the organization's underwriting philosophy, risk appetite, technical standards, and governance framework across all life and health insurance businesses. The role serves as a corporate risk subject matter expert on mortality, morbidity, product, underwriting, and fraud risks, providing underwriting risk management guidance to business units globally, with particular emphasis on emerging risks, high-net-worth markets, and the impact of underwriting and product design decisions on long-term business performance.

The incumbent will lead the evaluation and approval of underwriting and product-related risk initiatives, assess the mortality and morbidity implications of underwriting requirement changes, product innovations, and distribution strategies, and ensure alignment with corporate risk management objectives, with primary focus on our Asia business units and Private Wealth business. The role provides technical leadership to underwriters and input to actuarial, product development, and risk management teams on underwriting-specific risk while championing sound underwriting practices, risk governance, and sustainable growth.

Operating in a highly collaborative, consultative, and project-oriented environment, the Corporate AVP, Underwriting Risk & Governance will lead complex initiatives across the Asia business units and jurisdictions, influence business unit underwriting leadership and risk management decision-making, and represent the organization on underwriting and insurance industry matters under the direction of the Corporate Chief Underwriter.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Underwriting Governance

Support and champion corporate underwriting philosophy, risk appetite, and underwriting governance standards.
Provide enterprise oversight of underwriting practices across life, health, critical illness, disability, and medical reimbursement products.
Evaluate proposed changes to underwriting requirements, underwriting evidence, accelerated underwriting programs, automation initiatives, and digital underwriting solutions.
Assess and communicate the mortality and morbidity implications associated with underwriting and product design changes.

Mortality and Morbidity Risk Management

Evaluate mortality and morbidity risks associated with existing and proposed products, underwriting methodologies, and distribution strategies.
Assess the impact of product features, underwriting evidence requirements, and benefit structures on expected mortality and morbidity outcomes.
Partner with actuarial, product, and risk management teams to monitor emerging experience trends and recommend mitigation strategies.
Provide technical leadership on mortality and morbidity risk management across multiple markets.

Product and Anti-Selection Risk Assessment

Assess product design features for anti-selection, fraud, claims, and sustainability risks.
Identify underwriting controls, medical requirements, and risk management measures necessary to mitigate adverse selection and fraud exposure.
Provide risk guidance during new product development and product enhancement activities.
Evaluate the potential impact of product design changes on underwriting outcomes and claims experience.

Fraud Risk Oversight

Identify emerging fraud risks and vulnerabilities within underwriting and product frameworks.
Recommend underwriting, medical, and operational controls designed to mitigate fraud exposure.
Partner with claims, investigations, and risk management teams to identify trends and strengthen preventive measures.

High
-
Net
-
Worth and Complex Risk Expertise

Provide technical leadership on high-net-worth and Private Wealth underwriting practices, particularly within Asian markets.
Evaluate large face amount and complex financial underwriting cases.
Monitor market developments and emerging risk trends impacting high-net-worth and Private Wealth business.
Support business units in developing prudent underwriting strategies for complex and high-exposure risks.

Retention and Reinsurance Management

Provide leadership and guidance regarding retention management practices.
Evaluate retention limits, concentration risk, and reinsurance effectiveness.
Partner with reinsurance stakeholders as permitted to ensure alignment between underwriting strategies and risk transfer objectives.

Strategic Leadership

Lead complex cross-functional underwriting initiatives involving multiple business units, jurisdictions, and product lines.
Influence senior leaders and business partners on underwriting, mortality, morbidity, and product risk matters.
Provide strategic recommendations balancing growth opportunities with responsible risk management.
Serve as a trusted advisor to the Corporate Chief Underwriter on emerging underwriting and insurance risks.

Technical Thought Leadership

Research emerging medical, underwriting, product, and industry developments.
Participate in the development and maintenance of underwriting manuals, medical guidelines, and risk assessment standards.
Translate emerging medical evidence and industry research into practical underwriting guidance.
Represent the organization externally through industry associations, conferences, forums, and professional organizations.

What You'll Need To Succeed

Minimum 15 years of progressive life and health underwriting experience.
Minimum 5 years holding an individual underwriting approval authority of at least $30 million (preferred).
Significant experience assessing complex mortality and morbidity risks.
Experience underwriting high-net-worth and large face amount business, including exposure to Asian insurance markets.
Demonstrated experience evaluating underwriting implications of life, health, disability, critical illness, hospital indemnity, and medical reimbursement products.
Proven experience leading complex underwriting, governance, or risk initiatives across multiple business units or jurisdictions.
Experience working with reinsurance and retention management frameworks.
Experience developing underwriting philosophy, guidelines, manuals, and risk governance standards.
Proven ability to influence business risk management and underwriting leaders.
Strong strategic thinking and risk assessment capabilities.
Exceptional communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work independently with minimal direction while managing multiple concurrent priorities.
Strong collaboration skills with the ability to drive alignment across diverse stakeholders.
Comfortable operating in a dynamic environment focused on governance, consultation, project leadership, innovation, and enterprise risk oversight rather than production underwriting activities.

Preferred Designations

FALU
FLMI
Additional designations in risk management, supplemental health, or related disciplines.

What's In It For You

Being a member of the Sun Life family, a group of people united by our Purpose: to help Clients and Employees achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives.
In 2024, Sun Life ranked among the top 100 most sustainable global corporations by Corporate Knights for the 15th consecutive year, leading Canadian insurers.
We are proud to be on the 2024 Best Workplaces in Canada list by Great Place to Work.
We’re also listed as one of the Best Workplaces for Women and Best Workplaces with Most Trusted Executive Teams.
Our unique Sabbatical Program gives you the opportunity to take up to 6 weeks off, every five years.
Care Days available for self-care or care of others (i.e., family or others you may support) and Sick Days to support your well-being.

The Base Pay range is for the primary location for which the job is posted. It may vary depending on the work location of the successful candidate or other factors. In addition to Base Pay, eligible Sun Life employees participate in various incentive plans, payment under which is discretionary and subject to individual and company performance. Certain sales focused roles have sales incentive plans based on individual or group sales results.

Diversity and inclusion have always been at the core of our values at Sun Life. A diverse workforce with wide perspectives and creative ideas benefits our Clients, the communities where we operate and all of us as colleagues. We welcome applications from qualified individuals from all backgrounds.

Persons with disabilities who need accommodation in the application process, or those needing job postings in an alternative format, may e-mail a request to thebrightside@sunlife.com.

We are proud to be a hybrid organization that offers our employees the choice and flexibility to work from both the office and virtually based on the needs of the business, our Clients and you.

We may use artificial intelligence to support candidate sourcing, screening, interview scheduling.

jobs.title: Director EIAM Strategy &Technical Product Management (Global Security)
jobs.description:
Job Description

What is the opportunity?

The Director of EIAM Strategy & Technical Product Management
is responsible for defining and executing integrated product strategy across Royal Bank of Canada's Enterprise Identity and Access Management (EIAM) platform.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role
requiring deep engineering involvement and direct accountability for identity lifecycle management, authorization frameworks, governance capabilities, privileged access management, secrets management, and enterprise-wide identity architecture. The successful candidate will drive technical excellence across core security and compliance requirements while leveraging advanced technologies—including AI where appropriate—to enhance EIAM capabilities.

This role demands a technologist with proven hands-on experience designing and implementing complex identity systems, not a product manager focused on go-to-market or business development.

What will you do?

Own unified EIAM platform strategy and roadmap that incorporate emerging technologies and best practices spanning identity lifecycle for platforms such as authorization, authentication, governance, privileged access management, and secrets management
Work closely with lines of business to define and interpret business requirements and map them to appropriate technical specifications which can be leveraged to drive solution architectures and design
Act as a strategic liaison between vendor capabilities and RBC product requirements, ensuring solutions align with enterprise needs and maximize value delivery including driving direction of vendor product roadmap decisions
Evaluate vendor offerings against RBC's technical and business criteria to validate fit and identify capability gaps - Translate business requirements into actionable product roadmap items
Work with Solution and IAM Architects to facilitate disciplined decisions on access related solutions that address business needs within a resourcing and bandwidth context that include IAM engineering, integration and application support, operations and program teams
Prioritize, update, and modify strategies and roadmaps as business needs and vendor landscapes evolve while continuing to drive product strategy and accelerate multiple enterprise IAM initiatives
Serve as the primary point of contact for cross-functional stakeholders on IAM strategy and vendor integration decisions
Develop forward-looking roadmaps aligned with 2-year technology vision (including AI and PAM innovation trends)
Collaborate with Compliance and Risk teams to embed regulatory controls into product design
Mentor product and technical team members on identity architecture, governance strategy, and technical best practices

What do you need to succeed?

Must have:

10 + years of IAM experience, preferably in a financial institution/ large enterprise environment, with one of more of the following: Privileged Access Management (PAM), Secrets Management, Identity Governance & Administration (IGA), Authentication, Authorization, or Cloud/AI IAM solutions
5+ years of demonstrated experience translating business and compliance requirements into technical architecture and policy frameworks
Proven experience evaluating and liaising between vendor products and organizational requirements to ensure optimal solution alignment and value
Demonstrated experience developing and maintaining program and project-level roadmaps that align with architectural and organizational strategies
Proven ability to develop and own comprehensive IAM strategies that leverage emerging technologies and industry trends to address IAM requirements while aligning with Enterprise Architecture

new_jobs.title: Vice President, Global Consumer Data & Insights
new_jobs.description:
Your Opportunity at ARC’TERYX:

As the Vice President, Global Consumer Data & Insights, you are a trusted advisor and strategic partner to the Brand Leadership team and to the Enterprise organization, shaping the future of the Arc’teryx brand through deep consumer understanding and insight-led strategy. You will define and lead the company’s Consumer Insights vision, ensuring the voice of the consumer is embedded at the core of brand and business strategy, decision making and long-term growth.  In this role you influence critical business and brand decisions through compelling storytelling and foresight, translating complex data into clear direction for senior leaders.

Acting as a catalyst for a consumer-first culture, you lead the growth of the company’s insights capabilities, operating models, and tools while building a high-performing global team. You also champion innovation in how the organization anticipates and responds to shifting consumer behaviors, ensuring the brand remains culturally relevant and positioned for sustained growth.

Ideally this role is based out of our North Vancouver office.

Meet Your Future Team:

The Brand team is the direct connection between the guest and the core intention of the Arc’teryx brand. Leveraging an increasingly robust set of consumer insights, we specialize in storytelling and creating incredible experiences that connect people to the transformative power of the mountains. Our functions include enterprise strategy, brand marketing and creative, athletes/ambassador's programs, community, experiences, operations, communications, regional teams, and agency partners. This team is comprised of global HQ and regional offices who aim to become the voice of the consumer within the organization.  You will work in close partnership with functional leaders across channels and regions to bring added value to the business during this high growth era.

You and your team will also support wider executive leadership, aggregating data from commercial, product and business partners to derive insights that inform the enterprise growth strategy.

If you were in the VP, Global Consumer Data & Insights role now, here are some of the core activities you would be doing:

Setting the strategic vision and multi-year roadmap for the global Consumer Insights function, strengthening brand equity, distinctiveness, and consumer connection while ensuring alignment to brand positioning, growth priorities, and long-term strategy

Serving as the enterprise leader and trusted advisor for consumer insights, embedding a consumer-first operating model and insight-led perspectives that shape executive decisions, strategic planning, and innovation across all functions, regions, and business units.

Building, leading, and developing a high-performing global Consumer Insights team, including organizational design, capability building, and succession planning

Translating complex, multi-source data into clear narratives and lead the evolution of advanced analytics, including predictive, prescriptive, and AI-driven approaches, next-gen measurement, and marketing effectiveness/ROI tools, to drive measurable business outcomes

Designing and scaling a global insights operating model and enterprise frameworks — tools, platforms, KPIs, and standardized methodologies — and build strategic external partnerships (agencies, data providers, industry experts) to democratize access and ensure best-in-class capability

Leading consumer segmentation and consolidate data and insights systems across the enterprise (with focus on product, channel, and regional data), anticipating emerging consumer behaviors and market dynamics to unlock acquisition, retention, and growth opportunities

Here are some of the things you could be working on in the future:

Shaping the future of brand-building through next-generation insights, leveraging AI, real-time consumer signals, and emerging technologies to create more adaptive, responsive, and culturally relevant brand strategies

Pioneering new approaches to understanding consumer connection and brand experience, evolving beyond traditional research to integrate behavioral, emotional, and cultural intelligence at scale

Future-proofing the Brand by embedding predictive foresight and scenario planning, enabling the organization to anticipate disruption, stay ahead of shifting consumer expectations, and unlock long-term brand growth opportunities

Are you our next VP, Global Consumer Data & Insights?

You have 15+ years of progressive experience across brand, consumer insights, and strategy functions, with a bachelor's degree in a relevant field, and proven capability building consumer insights strategies and frameworks

You have demonstrated success influencing executive leadership, translating insights into brand strategy, positioning, and global brand-building initiatives that drive equity and long-term growth

You have strong analytical and technical fluency, including advanced analytics, predictive modeling, AI-driven insights, and consumer data ingestion, integration, and governance across a multi-market environment

You have an exceptional ability to synthesize complex data into compelling narratives that influence senior stakeholders and drive action

You are a proven people leader who sets clear vision, aligns global teams and cross-functional partners, and builds high-performing, diverse organizations within a complex matrix environment.

Your knowledge of technical apparel, outdoor, performance, or premium lifestyle categories, with in-depth understanding of the outdoor industry and the consumer culture Arc'teryx targets

You have a genuine passion for getting outside that matches your passion for the work

Compensation:
The salary range for this role is USD$224,000 - USD$336,000 

Total Rewards

Most new team members join between the start and midpoint of the range, where you can contribute right away while continuing to grow your craft, your collaborations, and your impact at Arc’teryx. This range reflects market alignment and the scope of the role. Individual pay is determined by your skills, experience, and level of responsibility.

We’re committed to fair, equitable, and competitive pay, reviewed regularly to ensure internal alignment and market relevance. Transparency is part of how we follow through on our commitments and how we honour the value you bring to our team.

In addition to base pay, Arc’teryx supports people through benefits designed to sustain both work and life:

- Extended health, dental, and vision coverage, including mental health support, fertility benefits, gender-affirming care and a 24/7 Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

y - Paid time off, wellness time, and No Wasted Day program (dedicated paid days to get outside & explore).

Family support

Growth, community & gear
- Professional development opportunities, Arc'teryx Academies (outdoor skill-building events) , Employee Belonging Councils, and access to employee discounts and Pro Deals (exclusive discounted pricing on gear).
  *Eligibility for certain programs may vary by role.

Equal Opportunity

Arc’teryx is committed to actively creating and fostering a culture of inclusivity where voices are heard, people are seen, and values are respected. We care about the uniqueness of our applicants, employees, and guests, and we do so in a safe space fueled by curiosity and acceptance. 

Creating an inclusive workplace is connected to our core value Do Right while also having the added benefit of helping make our business better. We believe inclusion helps us to create a healthier, happier workplace, drive creativity and innovation, and reflect the communities where we operate.  

All applicants, employees, and guests can expect equality of opportunity and fair treatment in alignment with our values.

Leave it Better

We believe that the mountains transform us, that how we adventure matters, and that there’s always a better way. 

Join us in creating positive change in ourselves, our communities, and the world. 

Live it. Get out there - the mountains make us better

Commit.  We set bold objectives and see them through.

new_jobs.title: Director, AI & Agentic Engineering
new_jobs.description:
About The Job

Do you think like a management consultant, thrive in a startup environment, and can’t stop thinking about the intersection of data, technology, and marketing?

With over 2000 employees, offices on five continents, and world-class clients like Samsung, L’Oreal, and Mattel, Artefact
is a consulting firm that transforms data into value and business impact. We’ve recently launched in the US with offices located in NYC and Los Angeles, and we want you to join us as an integral part of our founding team!

Who We Are

Founded and headquartered in Paris, Artefact is a next-generation consulting firm, specializing in data, analytics & AI consulting, dedicated to transforming data into business impact across the entire value chain of organizations. We are proud to say that we help our clients grow their data and digital capabilities, and that we’re also growing in parallel.

We have 2000 employees across 36 offices who are focused on accelerating digital transformation. Our state-of-the-art data technologies, lean AI agile methodologies, and cohesive teams of the finest business consultants, data analysts, data scientists, data engineers, and digital experts are all dedicated to bringing extra value to every client. We design data-based solutions to meet our clients' specific needs, always conceived with a business-centric approach and delivered with tangible results. Our data-driven services are built upon the deep AI expertise we've acquired with our 1000+ client base around the globe.

Find out more at artefact.com.

What You Will Be Doing

You will lead a team of AI & machine learning engineers and managers, driving the design and delivery of production-grade AI solutions — from classical machine learning models to LLM-powered applications — and the pipelines that power them. You’ll bring senior technical judgment to architecture and model decisions, partner closely with clients and business stakeholders — including hands-on pre-sales work shaping proposals and solution designs — and define how context engineering, agent harnesses, and fine-tuning practices get embedded into every solution, while reporting into senior AI/technology leadership on strategy and priorities.

AI & ML Solution Architecture: Leading the design, build, and optimization of production AI systems — classical machine learning models, LLM applications, and agentic systems — ensuring scalability, reliability, and cost-efficient inference.
Context Engineering: Defining and standardizing context engineering practices — prompt and system design, RAG architectures, vector stores, memory management, and tool/function calling — so models receive the right information at the right time.
Harness Engineering: Directing the build of robust agent harnesses — orchestration layers, evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and observability — that make LLM systems reliable, safe, and measurable in production.
Fine-Tuning Pipelines: Leading the design and operation of fine-tuning and model adaptation pipelines — training data curation, supervised fine-tuning, evaluation, and deployment — to specialize models for client use cases.
Platform Stack: Architecting and deploying solutions on Google Gemini Enterprise and Vertex AI as the primary stack, applying working knowledge of Microsoft AI Foundry and AWS Bedrock where client contexts require.
Team Leadership: Managing, mentoring, and developing a team of AI & ML engineers; setting technical standards and fostering best practices and knowledge sharing.
Pre-Sales & Business Development: Supporting pre-sales activities — scoping engagements, building demos and proofs of concept, and presenting solution architectures to prospective clients alongside account teams.
Machine Learning Modeling: Overseeing the development of classical and modern ML models — predictive modeling, forecasting, recommendation, and deep learning — choosing the right technique for each business problem, LLM or not.
Contributing to AI Strategy: Partnering with senior leadership to shape GenAI architecture direction, tooling decisions, and platform roadmap within your area.

What We Are Looking For

The ideal candidate has a substantial software engineering and AI background with 8+ years of experience, including at least 2–3 years working on LLM architecture, agentic design, and harness & context engineering.
Strong expertise in generative AI/LLM engineering — context engineering, agent harnesses, RAG, and agentic coding — and in cloud-native software architecture, with proven production deployments.
Master’s degree (or higher) in computer science, software engineering, or a related field.
Hands-on command of agentic SDKs (LangGraph/LangChain, Google ADK, Claude Agent SDK), agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Cursor), and modern full-stack frameworks (TypeScript/React front ends; Python/Node backends).
Experience designing cloud architectures: microservices, serverless, containers/Kubernetes, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code.
Solid grasp of AI system design: agents, tool use, evaluation harnesses, guardrails, observability, and LLMOps.
Experience with data & context modeling and ingestion/processing pipelines on data lakes and data warehouses, including vector and graph storage strategies (embeddings, knowledge graphs).
Deep experience with Google Gemini Enterprise / Vertex AI; basic working knowledge of Microsoft AI Foundry and AWS Bedrock.
Experience leading and growing engineering teams, and supporting pre-sales: proposals, demos, and solution scoping with clients.
Excellent communication skills and comfort collaborating across teams and with stakeholders.
Strong business acumen with an interest in business-facing work.
Adaptability and a start-up mentality to thrive in a dynamic environment.

Why Join Us

We are united by our values
and strengthened by our hybrid expertise
.

There is always a way: We're from the breed of does, of diggers, of makers. Because ideas are valuable only if executed.
Client trust is won on the field: Addressing client needs flows better hands on at their side.
If not used, it is useless: Our love for technology translates into a steep desire for adoption, true brilliance is about impact.
If not shared, our work is not done: Sharing knowledge is the best way to button up a mission, benefitting clients and colleagues.
We learn everyday: Tech is a land where everything moves at the speed of light, you better be ready to challenge yourself.

The estimated base compensation for this role starts at $200,000 (NYC location). Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, and experience. In addition, this role is eligible for competitive benefits.

When you join Sun Life, you'll work with passionate colleagues and empowering leaders who support your growth and celebrate your contributions, so you can make a meaningful difference in our Clients' lives.

Job Description:

About The Role

The Corporate AVP, Underwriting Risk & Governance is accountable for maintaining the organization's underwriting philosophy, risk appetite, technical standards, and governance framework across all life and health insurance businesses. The role serves as a corporate risk subject matter expert on mortality, morbidity, product, underwriting, and fraud risks, providing underwriting risk management guidance to business units globally, with particular emphasis on emerging risks, high-net-worth markets, and the impact of underwriting and product design decisions on long-term business performance.

The incumbent will lead the evaluation and approval of underwriting and product-related risk initiatives, assess the mortality and morbidity implications of underwriting requirement changes, product innovations, and distribution strategies, and ensure alignment with corporate risk management objectives, with primary focus on our Asia business units and Private Wealth business. The role provides technical leadership to underwriters and input to actuarial, product development, and risk management teams on underwriting-specific risk while championing sound underwriting practices, risk governance, and sustainable growth.

Operating in a highly collaborative, consultative, and project-oriented environment, the Corporate AVP, Underwriting Risk & Governance will lead complex initiatives across the Asia business units and jurisdictions, influence business unit underwriting leadership and risk management decision-making, and represent the organization on underwriting and insurance industry matters under the direction of the Corporate Chief Underwriter.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Underwriting Governance

Support and champion corporate underwriting philosophy, risk appetite, and underwriting governance standards.
Provide enterprise oversight of underwriting practices across life, health, critical illness, disability, and medical reimbursement products.
Evaluate proposed changes to underwriting requirements, underwriting evidence, accelerated underwriting programs, automation initiatives, and digital underwriting solutions.
Assess and communicate the mortality and morbidity implications associated with underwriting and product design changes.

Mortality and Morbidity Risk Management

Evaluate mortality and morbidity risks associated with existing and proposed products, underwriting methodologies, and distribution strategies.
Assess the impact of product features, underwriting evidence requirements, and benefit structures on expected mortality and morbidity outcomes.
Partner with actuarial, product, and risk management teams to monitor emerging experience trends and recommend mitigation strategies.
Provide technical leadership on mortality and morbidity risk management across multiple markets.

Product and Anti-Selection Risk Assessment

Assess product design features for anti-selection, fraud, claims, and sustainability risks.
Identify underwriting controls, medical requirements, and risk management measures necessary to mitigate adverse selection and fraud exposure.
Provide risk guidance during new product development and product enhancement activities.
Evaluate the potential impact of product design changes on underwriting outcomes and claims experience.

Fraud Risk Oversight

Identify emerging fraud risks and vulnerabilities within underwriting and product frameworks.
Recommend underwriting, medical, and operational controls designed to mitigate fraud exposure.
Partner with claims, investigations, and risk management teams to identify trends and strengthen preventive measures.

High
-
Net
-
Worth and Complex Risk Expertise

Provide technical leadership on high-net-worth and Private Wealth underwriting practices, particularly within Asian markets.
Evaluate large face amount and complex financial underwriting cases.
Monitor market developments and emerging risk trends impacting high-net-worth and Private Wealth business.
Support business units in developing prudent underwriting strategies for complex and high-exposure risks.

Retention and Reinsurance Management

Provide leadership and guidance regarding retention management practices.
Evaluate retention limits, concentration risk, and reinsurance effectiveness.
Partner with reinsurance stakeholders as permitted to ensure alignment between underwriting strategies and risk transfer objectives.

Strategic Leadership

Lead complex cross-functional underwriting initiatives involving multiple business units, jurisdictions, and product lines.
Influence senior leaders and business partners on underwriting, mortality, morbidity, and product risk matters.
Provide strategic recommendations balancing growth opportunities with responsible risk management.
Serve as a trusted advisor to the Corporate Chief Underwriter on emerging underwriting and insurance risks.

Technical Thought Leadership

Research emerging medical, underwriting, product, and industry developments.
Participate in the development and maintenance of underwriting manuals, medical guidelines, and risk assessment standards.
Translate emerging medical evidence and industry research into practical underwriting guidance.
Represent the organization externally through industry associations, conferences, forums, and professional organizations.

What You'll Need To Succeed

Minimum 15 years of progressive life and health underwriting experience.
Minimum 5 years holding an individual underwriting approval authority of at least $30 million (preferred).
Significant experience assessing complex mortality and morbidity risks.
Experience underwriting high-net-worth and large face amount business, including exposure to Asian insurance markets.
Demonstrated experience evaluating underwriting implications of life, health, disability, critical illness, hospital indemnity, and medical reimbursement products.
Proven experience leading complex underwriting, governance, or risk initiatives across multiple business units or jurisdictions.
Experience working with reinsurance and retention management frameworks.
Experience developing underwriting philosophy, guidelines, manuals, and risk governance standards.
Proven ability to influence business risk management and underwriting leaders.
Strong strategic thinking and risk assessment capabilities.
Exceptional communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work independently with minimal direction while managing multiple concurrent priorities.
Strong collaboration skills with the ability to drive alignment across diverse stakeholders.
Comfortable operating in a dynamic environment focused on governance, consultation, project leadership, innovation, and enterprise risk oversight rather than production underwriting activities.

Preferred Designations

FALU
FLMI
Additional designations in risk management, supplemental health, or related disciplines.

What's In It For You

Being a member of the Sun Life family, a group of people united by our Purpose: to help Clients and Employees achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives.
In 2024, Sun Life ranked among the top 100 most sustainable global corporations by Corporate Knights for the 15th consecutive year, leading Canadian insurers.
We are proud to be on the 2024 Best Workplaces in Canada list by Great Place to Work.
We’re also listed as one of the Best Workplaces for Women and Best Workplaces with Most Trusted Executive Teams.
Our unique Sabbatical Program gives you the opportunity to take up to 6 weeks off, every five years.
Care Days available for self-care or care of others (i.e., family or others you may support) and Sick Days to support your well-being.

new_jobs.description:
Job Description

What is the opportunity?

The Director of EIAM Strategy & Technical Product Management
is responsible for defining and executing integrated product strategy across Royal Bank of Canada's Enterprise Identity and Access Management (EIAM) platform.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role
requiring deep engineering involvement and direct accountability for identity lifecycle management, authorization frameworks, governance capabilities, privileged access management, secrets management, and enterprise-wide identity architecture. The successful candidate will drive technical excellence across core security and compliance requirements while leveraging advanced technologies—including AI where appropriate—to enhance EIAM capabilities.

This role demands a technologist with proven hands-on experience designing and implementing complex identity systems, not a product manager focused on go-to-market or business development.

What will you do?

Own unified EIAM platform strategy and roadmap that incorporate emerging technologies and best practices spanning identity lifecycle for platforms such as authorization, authentication, governance, privileged access management, and secrets management
Work closely with lines of business to define and interpret business requirements and map them to appropriate technical specifications which can be leveraged to drive solution architectures and design
Act as a strategic liaison between vendor capabilities and RBC product requirements, ensuring solutions align with enterprise needs and maximize value delivery including driving direction of vendor product roadmap decisions
Evaluate vendor offerings against RBC's technical and business criteria to validate fit and identify capability gaps - Translate business requirements into actionable product roadmap items
Work with Solution and IAM Architects to facilitate disciplined decisions on access related solutions that address business needs within a resourcing and bandwidth context that include IAM engineering, integration and application support, operations and program teams
Prioritize, update, and modify strategies and roadmaps as business needs and vendor landscapes evolve while continuing to drive product strategy and accelerate multiple enterprise IAM initiatives
Serve as the primary point of contact for cross-functional stakeholders on IAM strategy and vendor integration decisions
Develop forward-looking roadmaps aligned with 2-year technology vision (including AI and PAM innovation trends)
Collaborate with Compliance and Risk teams to embed regulatory controls into product design
Mentor product and technical team members on identity architecture, governance strategy, and technical best practices

What do you need to succeed?

Must have:

10 + years of IAM experience, preferably in a financial institution/ large enterprise environment, with one of more of the following: Privileged Access Management (PAM), Secrets Management, Identity Governance & Administration (IGA), Authentication, Authorization, or Cloud/AI IAM solutions
5+ years of demonstrated experience translating business and compliance requirements into technical architecture and policy frameworks
Proven experience evaluating and liaising between vendor products and organizational requirements to ensure optimal solution alignment and value
Demonstrated experience developing and maintaining program and project-level roadmaps that align with architectural and organizational strategies
Proven ability to develop and own comprehensive IAM strategies that leverage emerging technologies and industry trends to address IAM requirements while aligning with Enterprise Architecture
Experience working with one or more of the following: Idira (CyberArk), SailPoint, HashiCorp, Secrets Manager, Entra ID and other IAM related tools and platforms.
Strong track record of creating feasible, realistic roadmaps by incorporating cross-functional perspectives from IAM teams, Cyber Security, and different stakeholders groups
Strategic vision and proven track record translating complex IAM concepts—including authentication architecture, authorization frameworks, identity governance, privileged access management, and compliance landscapes—into cohesive product strategy and roadmap that drives business value.
Proven ability to lead cross-functional technical teams in complex, regulated banking/financial services environments
Proficiency with agile product delivery frameworks and automation technologies
Highly skilled at presenting to senior leadership and executives. Strong ability to communicate IAM strategy, progress, and critical updates in a clear, business-focused manner that resonates with C-suite audiences
Ability to determine the information and communication needs of the stakeholders and project.
Deadline-driven and results-oriented; able to meet consistently high quality standards while handling a variety of tasks and deadlines simultaneously
Excellent interpersonal skills to collaborate across functions and businesses

Nice-to-have
:

CISSP, CISM or other IAM specific certification
Experience with cloud identity platforms (Azure AD, Okta, AWS IAM); knowledge of zero-trust architecture and security frameworks; familiarity with compliance and regulatory requirements (SOC 2, ISO 27001)
Experience leading digital transformation initiatives
Background in Agile or Scrum methodologies
Exposure to API management and microservices security
Prior experience working with IAM configuration, or IAM architecture

What’s in it for you?

We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. We care about each other, reaching our potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.

A comprehensive Total Rewards Program including bonuses and flexible benefits, competitive compensation, commissions, and stock where applicable
Leaders who support your development through coaching and managing opportunities
Ability to make a difference and lasting impact
Work in a dynamic, collaborative, progressive, and high-performing team
A world-class training program in financial services
Opportunities to do challenging work
